findings.class: static receipt-coherence issue; not runtime reproduced
triggers: Invalid requested mode, physical preflight rejection, malformed/manufactured target or boundary, unresolved model target, invalid optional arguments or ranges before producer dispatch.
Beta construction failure after column/geopotential stages but before balance operator invocation.
findings.source_behavior: Producer stages are initialized STATUS_OK. Many early exits set top-level and overall failure but leave not-run producer receipts successful. Guards at lines 326-357 also leave overall at its initial FAILED/REASON_AUTHORITY; wrong-shaped omega_target or omega_target_sigma therefore gives top-level FAILED/REASON_SHAPE versus overall FAILED/REASON_AUTHORITY. Beta construction failure at 564-575 resets overall and changed masks but leaves balance STATUS_OK although balance has not run. The same skipped-stage issue occurs after column failure at 465-472 (balance remains STATUS_OK) and geopotential failure at 552-559 (balance remains STATUS_OK).
findings.consequence: Consumers may interpret skipped producer work as successful and may see conflicting failure reasons. Inspected rollback retains candidate and operational state at input.
findings.existing_evidence: tests/test_real_shadow_io_contract.f90:327-341 tests related writer authority rejection, and 467-474 tests the estimator receipt branch which explicitly marks stages failed; no assertions found for pre-stage or beta-failure receipts.
findings.next_check: With pinned Intel profile in a fresh scratch directory, add/run focused malformed target-shape and beta-failure fixtures asserting top-level, overall, producer receipts, and exact candidate/operational rollback. No fixture/test was run in this audit.
